facts.big: Could I / Could you + verbo base
facts.label: Pedidos educados com could
facts.sub: Para mim: Could I have…? Para outro: Could you call…? Depois de could, use o verbo base. Termine com please.

facts.label: Eu poderia…?
facts.sub: Use Could I + verbo base para pedir algo para você: Could I have a late check-out? Could I leave my luggage here? É educado e muito comum em hotéis.

facts.label: Você poderia…?
facts.sub: Use Could you + verbo base para pedir que outra pessoa faça algo: Could you call me a taxi? Could you sign this form? Termine com please se quiser ser ainda mais gentil.

compare.us: Em inglês, use Could you…? Could I…? + verbo base.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Could I have…? is a polite request.
We say “Could you to call a taxi?”
items.why: After could, use the base verb.

items.s: Could is softer than give me.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Could I have…? is a polite request. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “Could you to call a taxi?” → Falso (After could, use the base verb.)
Could is softer than give me. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Polite requests at a hotel · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a quiet Sunday in Cardiff, in the south of Wales. Zoe stands at the front desk with a small bag. Her train to London leaves late in the evening. Bree, the receptionist, smiles and waits. Zoe wants to ask for some small favors. She remembers to be polite, so she uses could.

“Good morning, Zoe. How was your stay at our hotel in Cardiff?” says Bree. “Lovely, thank you. Could I have a late check-out today?” says Zoe. “Of course. Could you tell me the time? Checkout is usually at eleven.” says Bree.
